In case of bunch bids, the primary product having highest value should meet this criterion. 6. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. 7. Turnover OEM Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the OEM of the offered product during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the OEM is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. In case of bunch bids, the OEM of CATEGORY RELATED TO primary product having highest bid value should meet this criterion. 8. Service & Support Availability of Service Centres: Bidder/OEM must have a Functional Service Centre in the State of each Consignee's Location in case of carry-in warranty. (Not applicable in case of goods having on-site warranty). If service center is not already there at the time of bidding, successful bidder / OEM shall have to establish one within 30 days of award of contract. Payment shall be released only after submission of documentary evidence of having Functional Service Centre. 9. cil (i) Documentary Proof Indicating the Presence of a registered office or branch office situated in Shillong city. 1. Trading License: In compliance to the Govt. of Meghalaya letter No.DCA.36 /91/323 dated: 24.06.2022. Non-Tribal Bidders has to furnish trading license iss ued from the KHADC (Khasi Hills Autonomous District Council) failing which the bid may be rejected. The Bidders have to submit valid Trading License issued from the KHADC (Khasi Hills Autonomous District Council) or any other relevant document for exempti on. Acceptable docume nts include, but are not limited to, registration certificates, trade licenses, or an y official document issued by a recognized government authority that clearly in dicates the location and operational status of the office/service center within Sh illong. Failure to provide this documentation will result in the disqualification of t he bid. 2. Financial Stability: (i) Submission of audited financial statements for the last three financial years ( 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). (ii) The financial statements shall include only those transactions, reve nues, and expenditures that are directly related to the supply of simila r medical items. 3. The successful bidder shall complete the installation of the reagents/ controls / calibrators supplied. 5. Payment for the supply of the machine will be considered only after successf ul installation of the reagents/ controls/ calibrators, along with the submission of the Installation Report to the Institute. 6. The warranty period shall be for a minimum of 01 (one) year or high er. 7. The Ferritin Kit should compatible with the existing Ichroma III. . 10. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC
